# shc_billing (Data Source)

Fetches account billing information: current balance, credit, and recent invoices.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `balance` (String) The current account balance.
- `credit` (String) Available credit.
- `currency` (String) The account currency (e.g. USD).
- `invoices` (Attributes List) Recent invoices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invoices))

<a id="nestedatt--invoices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invoices`

Read-Only:

- `date_created` (String) Date the invoice was created.
- `date_due` (String) Date the invoice is due.
- `invoice_id` (String) The invoice ID.
- `status` (String) Invoice status (open, paid, etc.).
- `total` (String) The invoice total.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "shc_billing" "current" {}

output "credit_balance" {
  value = data.shc_billing.current.credit
}

output "open_invoices" {
  value = [for inv in data.shc_billing.current.invoices : inv.total if inv.status == "open"]
}
```
